question: Which memory-wiki isolation contract should OpenClaw support for shared-gateway multi-agent setups: plugin-owned per-agent vault routing, generic `agents.list[].plugins` overrides, or explicitly unsupported shared-gateway isolation?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses plugin config, public schema, memory isolation, background jobs, and upgrade behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API/security contract.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned vault isolation
options.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent vault resolver first, with explicit precedence, CLI/gateway behavior, docs, doctor checks, and regression proof while leaving the broader plugin override issue separate.

options.title: Wait for generic per-agent plugin config
options.body: Treat #55401 as the API owner and keep memory-wiki unchanged until the generic plugin config merge contract is designed and reviewed.

options.title: Document unsupported shared-gateway isolation
options.body: State that memory-wiki remains one global vault per gateway for now and require separate OpenClaw installations or disabled memory-wiki for strict multi-tenant boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned vault isolation
recommendation.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent vault resolver first, with explicit precedence, CLI/gateway behavior, docs, doctor checks, and regression proof while leaving the broader plugin override issue separate.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision primarily affects plugin/config schema and security-sensitive multi-agent runtime boundaries where steipete has the broadest recent ownership signal.
